summary: The exact change correctly fences provider refreshes against superseded loads, target/token changes, deactivation, and hidden-tab invalidation.

evidence: static/admin-supervisor.js:211-232 gives provider loads their own AbortController and generation ID, passing the signal to both requests.
static/admin-supervisor.js:237-263 rejects superseded, aborted, inactive, target-changed, or token-changed responses before rendering or clearing the provider list.
static/admin-supervisor.js:849-855 and 939-946 abort and invalidate provider loads when the tab is hidden or the view is deactivated.
